script.base: Books have a one-point game and a 54 total, so the base script is a competitive shootout, not a grind or a blowout. DAL is the slight favorite (27.5 implied) but GB is only +1, short of the 3.5 underdog-throws-more trigger, and there is no blowout flag on starter snaps. Both passing games stay live: Dak's L3 air-yard stack is Lamb 34 targets/310 yards/300 air and Pickens 27/287/280, while Love's is Golden 26/244/397 and Watson 21/286/293. Javonte remains the DAL every-down back (50 carries/205 yards L3) without a late clock-kill script locked in. GB's backfield stays a committee (Lloyd 21/55, K. Johnson 19/74).
script.flip1: DAL gets up early, hands Javonte the clock, and his receiving stalls while GB abandons the run. Lloyd's carries die and Watson/Golden/Kraft targets spike. That flip helps a GB pass over and hurts a Javonte receiving over.
script.flip2: Unsaved Lambeau weather or a sudden slog drags the 54 down, or GB's 34% blitz (Dak EPA/db 0.05 vs blitz, 0.27 with no blitz) takes away Dallas explosives and funnels the ball to checkdowns. Deep WR yards miss; RB/TE catches rise. Watson over dies in this flip; Javonte receiving over is helped by the blitz version and hurt by a true weather slog.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both legs lost. Green Bay did not need Watson: Golden's 397 air yards took the shots against Durant's replacement, Porter and Speed played, and Watson posted another 47-yard game after the 143 proved to be one long catch. On the other side GB blitzed less than 34% or Dak beat it to Lamb and Pickens, Javonte repeated his 5-yard receiving line while still getting 15 carries, and a small DAL lead turned the fourth quarter into handoffs. The 54 never showed up because unsaved Lambeau weather shortened both passing games. That counter is real enough to keep both at lean, not strong, but it is not stronger than the CB-injury plus blitz reads, so the legs stay.
slip_story: One script only: competitive 54-point pass game, DAL -1, both quarterbacks on the field all night. Stack is Watson recyds over (GB pass vs a short-handed DAL secondary) with Javonte recyds over (DAL checkdowns vs a 34% blitz). They win together if the game stays live and pass-heavy. They lose together in a weather slog. Do not mix with a game under, a TD, or a second market on either player. Lloyd under is a different story and was left off.
